name: EU Cyber Resilience Act
description: Establishes mandatory cybersecurity requirements for products with digital elements placed on the EU market, including AI software components, secure development lifecycle, and continuous vulnerability management.
applicability_conditions: Manufacturers and developers of software or hardware products with digital elements placed on the EU market

requirements.title: Security by Design and Default
requirements.normalized_requirement: Products with digital elements, including AI applications, shall be designed, developed, and produced in such a way that they ensure an appropriate level of cybersecurity based on the risks, delivering products with secure default configurations.
requirements.applicability: Commercial software and digital products in EU
requirements.implementation_guidance: Implement secure defaults, disable unnecessary ports and APIs, and enforce mandatory authentication.

requirements.title: Software Bill of Materials (SBOM)
requirements.normalized_requirement: Manufacturers shall identify and document components and vulnerabilities, including drawing up a Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) in a commonly used, machine-readable format covering at the very least top-level dependencies.
requirements.implementation_guidance: Generate automated SBOMs (SPDX / CycloneDX) for all software builds and AI component containers.

requirements.title: Vulnerability Handling and Disclosure
requirements.normalized_requirement: Organizations shall put in place a coordinated vulnerability disclosure policy, perform regular security tests, and deploy security updates without delay.
requirements.implementation_guidance: Establish a vulnerability disclosure policy and automated patch management workflow.
